title: Legacy P2SH multisig

schema.keys: 33 or 65 bytes, and only in P2SH

note: A bare legacy multisig in a P2SH redeem script. A 65-byte key in P2WSH is not a key under this policy, because segwit will not let an uncompressed key sign, so that script is not this row. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.
